page.layout: One printed page of running text in a single column. Running head at top, page number at top left. Small marginal marks at the lower left, beside the last lines.

main_text.p: agere, quod cæperat, non posset, tandem ab ephoris cæteris in gratiam Leonidæ per summum scelus in carcerem abreptus, ibique cum matre & aviâ,fœminis optimis,manu carnificis strangulatus vitam finiit, regum Spartanorum integerrimus, & publici boni amantissimus. Non diu post Leonidæ defuncto succefsit in regnum filius ejus Cleomenes, ingenio peracri, excelso, audaci,sed æquè vafro, magnæ potentiæ ac famæ parandæ avidissimo: quod ejus ingenium velut in speculo repræsentatum in parallelis suis depingit Plutarchus.De rebus ejusce, quoniam autore eo maxima reipublicæ facta est conversio, dicemus paulò prolixius. Duxerat vivente adhuc,& pene cogente patre conjugem Agiatidem, Agidis regis occisi viduam, Gylippi filiam, magnas opes possidentem, indole & formâ eximiam, inimicissimam Leonidæ,sed utriusque mariti amantissimam: à quâ Agidis instituta & consilia in administrandis privatis publicisque negociis,cujus gratam universo populo memoriam esse videbat, perdidicit. Ad ejus igitur imitationem ini-tio sese componens civibus benignum, facilem, affabilem se ferebat, eratque in veste, & omni vitæ ratione adstrictus, luxum omnem & regium fastum aver-sans,XXII

page.notes: The two small Roman-numeral marks at the lower left (XX and II) sit beside the last lines, and I cannot tell whether they are marginal section marks or a gathering signature; they are recorded as left-margin notes. The running head is set in small capitals and is given here as "Descriptio". The hyphenated word "aver-sans" is split across the line end and rejoined with its printed hyphen. No doubtful readings in the body text.
